payload.purpose_context: Building the controller-first UI by hand-painting every rect in egui has cost far more effort than the design warrants; a one-day spike (spike/webview-mixer, Op 01KZ9CN8E0YEMQEZQG8Q7VEESM) rendered the full authored MIXER screen from the production SemanticGraphicalViewModel JSON in 244 lines of HTML/CSS, replacing the density-policy arithmetic with one CSS grid rule. This mission makes that real: a Tauri v2 window whose webview renders the MIXER context at authored-design parity — projection, focus, adjustment, meters — while physical input capture, the reducer, and the real-time audio boundaries stay exactly where DESIGN.md puts them. The webview is a projection surface only; the egui shell remains the running default behind a flag. PATCH, modals, and egui retirement follow in a successor mission.
payload.purpose_tldr: Replace the hand-painted egui rendering of the MIXER screen with a Tauri webview projection surface fed by the existing semantic view model, behind a flag, with egui still the default.

review.reference: Review passed: NSEvent local-monitor verdict verified. I independently confirmed the API-shape claim in vendored source: tauri-2.11.5/src/app.rs:111 WindowEvent has no keyboard variant (zero KeyboardInput refs in the crate; tao 0.35.3 has it but tauri-runtime-wry-2.11.4 never maps it), so the tao path fails structurally and the monitor is the only viable path regardless of any hardware sweep. Ruling on synthetic evidence: ACCEPTED for this probe WP — the local monitor intercepts on the in-process queue before sendEvent:/responder dispatch (focus routing happens after the monitor), and the synthetic sweep proved mechanism, keycode normalization, and production translator wiring end-to-end (Edit-hold, Shift identity, unbound-key invariant). The residual (hardware sweep at an unlocked session, i.e. real window-server focus routing) is low-risk and explicitly covered downstream by WP02's manual key check and WP06's live layer; the limitation was disclosed honestly with the failed locked-session injection attempt documented. PROBE_RT audio-coexistence logs are internally consistent (48000 frames/s sustained, exactly 256 frames/block every snapshot, realistic jitter, clean CloseRequested->Destroyed->exit). cargo build green; full suite 896 passed / 0 failed / 2 ignored — matches claim, no regressions. input_capture.rs carries only the winning path with install(sink) as specified; page registers no key handler; tauri unconditional (no feature gate); eframe path untouched (src diff = probe bin + webview module + 1-line mod registration); out-of-map touches (build.rs append after vendor compile, window-only tauri.conf.json, 105-byte icon, /gen/schemas/ gitignore) minimal and documented. Anti-pattern checklist: 1 dead-code PASS (probe bin is live caller; WP02 is declared durable consumer), 2 synthetic-fixture PASS, 3 silent-empty PASS, 4 FR-003 coverage PASS, 5 frozen-surface PASS, 6 locked-decision PASS, 7 shared-file PASS, 8 fragility PASS (typed InputCaptureError per FR-007).

Generation-gating proven by unit test (same gen -> no emit, changed -> one emit). RULING gate-on-success: APPROVED — advancing the gate only on successful emit means an accepted document is never silently lost, satisfying 'typed and not swallowed'; teardown tolerance is structural (WindowEvent::Destroyed sets close_requested before any teardown emit can fail), and while-alive failures take the exact eframe record-first-error-and-close-once path (get_or_insert + close, surfaced after run_return), matching the WP's eframe-parity wording. Meter channel: single Option pending slot (queue depth bounded at one by construction), METER_RATE_HZ=30 named with NFR-002 pointer, METER_INTERVAL derived (no 33 ms literal), loss semantics documented as display-only; AudioObservationSnapshot Serialize verified pre-existing at mission base (no lane commit touched src/real_time or src/control). window.rs/mod.rs edits are the minimal WP02 seam completion (imports, channels+error slot before run_return, Destroyed handler, MainEventsCleared emission, post-loop error surfacing) — nothing else changed; out-of-map wiring acknowledged as the seam left for WP03. RULING page-receipt deferral: ACCEPTED — withGlobalTauri:false makes page-side listening structurally impossible until WP05; the byte-equality test plus emit-path inspection satisfies FR-004 at this WP's boundary; WP05 review must re-verify page-visible receipt. RT callback untouched by inspection (commit touches only shell/webview; both channels read control-side accessors on the event thread). 10 channel unit tests green (one more than the 9 claimed), full suite 31 targets green, clippy --all-targets clean. Anti-pattern checklist: all 8 PASS.
